summary: [a] Round 2 a1 resolved. The plan now reads LIMIT_BUDGET_MIB from the trusted baseline revision, records the revision/blob hash/extracted value, rejects missing/duplicate/malformed baseline metadata without candidate fallback, and builds fixed-policy input from candidate rows plus the trusted budget (implementation.md:56-59; issues/04-validation-publication.md:30-44; design.md:224-243). The repository’s current parser confirms the prior risk source: ledger-to-json.ts derives budget from the input file (lines 10-13), while the new plan explicitly avoids passing that candidate JSON directly and requires separate row parsing and baseline-budget injection. The added regression cases cover simultaneous row/budget increases, metadata-only changes, malformed or deleted candidate metadata, and malformed baseline metadata (issues/04-validation-publication.md:64-72). No new critical or high issue was introduced by this fix.
